column1: # Curated: the fuel mix of new cars by model year, as fuel:year=share anchors, interpolated linearly between anchors and held before the first and after the last; petrol is what is left. Rounded from ACEA's diesel shares, national registration statistics, the IEA Global EV Outlook and makers' figures. Where Eurostat (road_eqr_carpda, 2013 on) or the IEA (electric and plug-in shares, 2010 on) measure a country, scripts/prepare_data.py uses the measurement for those years and these anchors only before them.
